description.en:
TienKung Omni is X-Humanoid's compact, open development platform for embodied-intelligence research, education and robotics competitions. It exposes interfaces for joint sensing, system functions and motion control so developers can build their own behaviors rather than relying only on preconfigured demonstrations.

The range includes a flagship configuration with 31 degrees of freedom and options for dexterous hands, teleoperation and data-collection equipment. Depth sensing, lidar and inertial measurements support perception and movement development. X-Humanoid describes applications spanning guided services and experiments with household or industrial tasks. Computing, sensing and accessories vary by configuration, which should be checked before transferring results between editions.

specs.conditions: Manufacturer claims autonomous recovery after a fall; no independently verified reliability rate.
